_about: Blocking box grasp on pp_box (experiment 1, static gate). Lengths in metres, times in seconds.

stand._about: Robot stays in front of the table and never walks (--stand-still). Depth: box centre behind the table's near edge; lateral: to the robot's left. The map is measured first; region and stance_extra_m are fixed from it by the rule in _region_rule and not changed afterwards.
stand._region_rule: A map cell stands for the square of half a grid step around its point. For each stance distance take the rectangle of whole cells with the most cells whose episodes, both yaws pooled, succeed at >= 90%; ties: higher rate, wider lateral span, nearer stance. Pulling each outer edge in by half a grid step leaves the span between the outermost measured points. Code: report_grasp.py --pick-region.

region._from: exp1-map-20261124-m1-* (commit c954487) by report_grasp.py --pick-region: 11 of 12 episodes in the rectangle; fixed 2026-11-24, not to be changed

stand._conditions: Changed 2026-11-25 by the user's decision: speeds 0.03 and 0.10 m/s only (0.30 on a 10 cm segment only jitters like 0.10); delays 75 steps (local Qwen, 1.37 s), 194 (GPT-6.2 Astra median 3.88 s), 383 (Gemini 4 Argon median 7.66 s); every condition on the region seeds.

wide._about: The robot walks from the task's start every round (--box-wide --native-walk). The box is at a seeded place: depth (box centre behind the table's near edge) in the range validated standing still, world y over the task's own reset range, yaw within +-max_yaw_deg. The walk is the official-way Kimodo walk of experiment two (kimodo_vla/oracle/grasp_walk.py) to the stance rule moved back by stance_extra_m (validated standing still) and sideways so that the box ends box_lateral_m to the robot's left: -0.05 is the middle of the lateral span validated standing still (-0.10 to 0).
wide._box_y: Task reset range of the box (move_pickplace_box_g1_29dof_dex3_wholebody), 1.71 m; every yaw up to 45 degrees keeps the box fully over the table top (y from -6.237 to -3.763) at both ends.

walk._about: Experiment two's native setting (native-generation-20261125.md): 1 s replans of 5 s segments, 5 transition frames, approach gain 2, no text, 100 DDIM steps, 0.35 m/s path, stop within 5 cm.

wide._episode_steps: Every wide condition, static and moving: the longest delay (383 steps) still fits two whole rounds with the walk (measured on the debug seeds), see wide-range-20261125.md
